title: Choose the visual world for Idea Bank
question: Re-roll 1: the roll assigned Day-Colour Ribbons. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Day-Colour Ribbons
options.lineage: สีประจำวัน, the Thai seven-colour day system, and ผ้าเจ็ดสี ribbons
options.thesis: Every Thai reader already decodes colour as identity; each idea wears a short ribbon of its track and SDG colours.
options.viewport: Filters left, idea rows right; each row starts with a thin vertical ribbon of its track and SDG colours, score numerals in tabular figures at the end.
options.risk: Seven colours can tip into rainbow noise; colour must stay on ribbons and chips only, never on surfaces.

raised.raise: One colour is reserved for 'shortlisted' and appears nowhere else.
All scores in strict tabular figures, columns aligned across rows.
Selection is a colour fill, not added borders or button chrome.
Track filter rail shows each track's size proportionally.

options.label: OMR Answer Sheet
options.lineage: Thai exam answer sheets: ฝนให้เต็มวง
options.thesis: Scores read like filled answer bubbles: P, B, D, C each a row of five circles.
options.viewport: List shell; each idea shows a 4×5 bubble grid for its scores; compare stacks the grids.
options.risk: Familiar form look; can feel like school paperwork.

options.label: Airport Yellow Signage
options.lineage: airport wayfinding bands (Suvarnabhumi uses yellow and black too)
options.thesis: Narrowing 145 ideas is a chain of decision points; each screen shows only the choices ahead.
options.viewport: A sticky yellow band shows the current decision (track, then shortlist, then compare); idea list below in black on white.
options.case: Strong on product clarity for a decision tool; ties on audience identification.
options.risk: Yellow-black band can read as an airport costume if used beyond the decision band.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.thesis: Ideas rerank in place like flights; the shortlist is your boarding pass.
options.viewport: Ranked board of ideas with fixed columns; shortlisted ideas collect as a segmented pass on the side.
options.case: Rerank-in-place fits sorting and scoring; team identification is moderate.
options.risk: Travel metaphor is borrowed, not the team's own world.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Ideas as barcode columns in pure black and white.
options.viewport: A strobing field of idea columns.
options.case: Decorative and hard to read in Thai; loses both axes.
options.risk: Strobing and pure black are hostile to long reading.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: Giant cropped lowercase and flat tiles.
options.case: Lowercase cropping does not exist in Thai script; loses audience.
options.kept: Selection as colour fill, no chrome.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Ideas as controls on a course.
options.case: Foreign to the team; clarity weak.
options.kept: One reserved colour for the active path.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Tracks as divider boards with tabs.
options.case: Rich but heavy; loses on clarity.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean product dashboard: sidebar filters, card grid, side panel.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, search bar, card grid, slide-over detail.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every SaaS template, which the team asked to avoid.
